maya: Quick follow-up from INC-5423 postmortem. We need: compact triage checklist, exact mitigation cmds, clear owner for runbook upkeep, and sprint work for a durable detector. Please claim items + ETA.

sanjay: I can take the triage checklist and mitigation commands. Will include expected outputs and rollback criteria. ETA: 2026-04-02.

omar: I'll wire the alert -> ticket automation and provide a ticket template. ETA: 2026-04-04. Suggest auto-assign to a `runbook-rotation` group.

jun: I'll coordinate sprint capacity and schedule a 1-day remediation card for the next sprint. Also propose a 90-day rotation for owners.

ops-bot: Created INF-8250 and linked to postmortem: https://tickets.redwood/INF-8250 (runbook + alert + rotation).

sanjay: Draft checklist to add to runbook (short form):
1) check recent logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=30m | grep -i KVCache`
2) pod id: `POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')`
3) evict (safe): `kubectl -n inference exec -it $POD -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/cache/evict"`
4) post-evict smoke: monitor 5m for >0.5% 5xx or CPU >85% -> rollback.

rachel: Can you add expected responses? e.g., evict returns `\{\"status\":\"ok\"\}` and metric `kv_cache_entries` should drop by ~10-15%. That helps on-call validation.

sanjay: Yes — adding expected outputs and grep examples. Also adding a short FAQ: "When not to evict" (during heavy batch windows).

omar: Alert pseudo-rule I'll implement (Datadog): `sum(eviction_signature{service:inference} by 24h) >= 3 OR increase(inference_service_p99_ms[10m]) > 180` -> create INF-8250 ticket, tag `runbook-rotation`, page infra-oncall. Ticket template fields: owner, ETA(48h), playbook link, recent-logs link.

jun: Rotation plan: owners rotate every 90 days; ops-bot posts a reminder 14 days before handoff. I'll update OWNERS in runbooks and calendar.

ops-bot: INF-8250 subtasks created: INF-8250-1 (runbook edits) -> sanjay; INF-8250-2 (alert wiring) -> omar; INF-8250-3 (rotation + calendar) -> jun.

sanjay: Opening PR with runbook snippet now: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pull/534 — includes checklist, commands, expected outputs, and rollback steps.

rachel: Quick validation note: I ran the evict in staging this morning; returned `\{\"status\":\"ok\"\}`, `kv_cache_entries` dropped ~12%, no 5xx spike in 10m. Left comment on PR about wording.

omar: Alert wired and test ticket created (auto-tagged). Will monitor for 7 days for noise.

jun: OWNERS updated and first rotation scheduled for 2026-05-01. Ops-bot reminder queued.

(3 days later)
sanjay: PR merged: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/9d8b7a  runbook updated and small play added. Marking INF-8250-1 done.
omar: Alert live; test ticket flow OK. Monitoring window started.

maya: Thanks team. Next steps: 1) confirm no false positives in 7d, 2) run a short remediation drill next sprint, 3) confirm rotation handoff goes smoothly. If anything slips, update INF-8250. :white_check_mark:
